overview: Defender Ops is a multi-cloud SecOps platform for AWS, Azure, and GCP with a centralized per-provider secure vault for credentials, API keys, and secrets.
features: Store arbitrary named secrets per cloud provider in a centralized vault
Encrypt secrets at rest in the backend canister
Allow authorized admins to reveal or decrypt secrets on demand
Enforce per-provider access control on vault operations
Record every vault action in the audit log
